items.title: 形容词作定语与表语的位置限制
items.brief: a- 开头多只作表语，main/only 只作定语

concept.summary: 形容词分三类：绝大多数既能作定语又能作表语；以 a- 开头的（asleep, awake, alive, alone, afraid, aware, ashamed, alike, ill）只能作表语；main, chief, only, mere, utter, elder 只能作定语。判定方法是把这个词分别放到名词前和 be 动词后各试一次，哪一边不通就记住这一边。

sections.p: 这类词多源自中世纪英语的介词短语，历史上就不能直接修饰名词。它们出现在名词前时必须换成同义的定语形容词，不能靠加冠词补救。
bullets: asleep → a sleeping baby；afraid → a frightened child
alive → a living writer / a live fish；alone → a lone traveller
ill → a sick man；well（健康）→ a healthy man
其余高频：awake, aware, ashamed, alike, unable, worth

sections.p: 这类词表示等级、顺序或强调，语义上依附于名词中心语，不能独立作表语。把它们放到 be 动词后，句子在语义上就不成立。
bullets: main, chief, principal：the main reason，× The reason is main.
only, mere, utter, sole：a mere child，× The child is mere.
elder / eldest 指家庭成员的长幼：my elder sister
former / latter, inner / outer, daily / weekly 也只作定语

sections.p: 系动词后是表语位置，除 be 之外还包括 seem, look, feel, become, remain, stay, sound, taste, smell。副词修饰表语形容词时位置固定，fast asleep、wide awake、fully aware 都是固定搭配。
bullets: She felt alone in the new city.
The baby is fast asleep.
He remained silent throughout the meeting.

examples.en: The baby is fast asleep in the crib.
examples.zh: 婴儿在婴儿床里睡得很熟。
examples.note: asleep 只作表语，位于系动词 is 之后，fast 是固定修饰语。

examples.en: The asleep baby is in the crib.
examples.zh: 睡着的婴儿在婴儿床里。
examples.note: asleep 不能作前置定语，应改为 the sleeping baby。

examples.en: He was ill for a week and missed two exams.
examples.zh: 他病了一周，错过了两场考试。
examples.note: ill 表“生病”时只作表语，此处位于 was 之后。

examples.en: He is an ill man and needs rest.
examples.zh: 他是个病人，需要休息。
examples.note: ill 不能作定语修饰 man，应改为 a sick man。

examples.en: This is the main entrance to the building.
examples.zh: 这是大楼的主入口。
examples.note: main 只作定语，位置在名词 entrance 之前。

examples.en: The entrance of the building is main.
examples.zh: 大楼的入口是主要的。
examples.note: main 不能作表语，应改为 The main entrance is...

examples.en: The two brothers look very much alike.
examples.zh: 这两兄弟长得很像。
examples.note: alike 只作表语，用 very much 而不是 very 修饰。

pitfalls.wrong: The asleep child was carried upstairs.
pitfalls.right: The sleeping child was carried upstairs.
pitfalls.why: asleep 只能作表语，作前置定语必须换成 sleeping。

pitfalls.wrong: He bought an alive fish at the market.
pitfalls.right: He bought a live fish at the market.
pitfalls.why: alive 只作表语，修饰名词表“活的”要用 live。

pitfalls.wrong: The reason he gave for being late was main.
pitfalls.right: The main reason he gave for being late was the weather.
pitfalls.why: main 只作定语，不能放在系动词后作表语。

contrast.withTitle: 形容词后置定语的情形
contrast.diff: 这一节点判断形容词能不能作定语；后置定语判断能作定语的形容词在什么条件下必须移到名词后面。

concept.mnemonic: a- 开头多表语，main/only 只定语；要前置先换词，asleep 换 sleeping。

core: 表语专用：asleep, awake, alive, alone, afraid, aware, ashamed, alike, ill, worth
定语专用：main, chief, only, mere, utter, elder, former, inner
表语形容词作定语要换词：sleeping / frightened / live / sick
系动词后为表语位置：be, seem, look, feel, become, remain, taste
固定搭配：fast asleep, wide awake, fully aware
review.trigger: 看到 a- 开头的形容词想放名词前 → 立刻换成对应的定语形容词

quickCheck.a: a sleeping child，不能用 asleep。
不能，只能说 the main reason。

quickCheck.q: “他病了”与“他是个病人”分别怎么说？
quickCheck.a: He is ill. / He is a sick man.

drills.stem: The baby has been ___ for two hours and is crying again.
drills.answer: awake
drills.explain: has been 后需要形容词作表语，awake 表示“醒着的”，符合此处状态。
drills.trap: wake 与 waken 都是动词，不能直接放在 be 动词后作表语。

drills.stem: Although he lives ___ in the village, he never feels lonely. (alone)
drills.answer: alone
accept: alone
drills.hint: live 后需要表语形容词，括号中的词本身即为形容词。
drills.explain: alone 只作表语，放在 lives 之后表示“独自居住”；lonely 表“孤独的”，与后半句形成对比。

drills.stem: She keeps an asleep cat on the sofa all afternoon.
drills.answer: She keeps a sleeping cat on the sofa all afternoon.
accept: She keeps a sleeping cat on the sofa all afternoon.
drills.explain: asleep 只能作表语，修饰名词 cat 必须换成 sleeping，同时冠词由 an 改为 a。

drills.stem: Safety is the ___ concern of every airline.
drills.answer: chief
drills.explain: concern 前需要定语形容词，chief 表示“主要的”，只作定语。
drills.trap: chiefly 是副词，不能修饰名词 concern；chief 本身没有比较级和最高级形式。

drills.stem: 这个睡着的孩子是他唯一的儿子。
drills.answer: The sleeping child is his only son.
drills.explain: asleep 不能作定语，须改用 sleeping；only 只作定语，直接放在名词前。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The two sisters look very much alike.
drills.explain: alike 只作表语，位于系动词 look 之后，且用 very much 修饰。

items.title: 形容词后置定语的情形
items.brief: 不定代词、表语形容词、度量短语都要后置

concept.summary: 形容词后置有四个触发条件：修饰 some/any/no/every 构成的不定代词；形容词本身只能作表语（present, alive, asleep, available）；形容词短语带度量或介词短语（two hundred years old）；以及 best/only/first + 名词 + available/possible 这类固定搭配。除此之外，形容词一律前置。

sections.h: 修饰不定代词必须后置
sections.p: something, anything, nothing, everything, someone, anybody, nobody 等由 some/any/no/every 合成的代词，自身已带限定成分，形容词只能跟在后面。else 也遵循同一条规则。
bullets: something important；nothing new；anything else
everyone present；nobody alive
× important something；× new nothing

sections.h: 表语形容词作定语要后置
sections.p: present, alive, asleep, available, awake 等词不能放在名词前，但可以放在名词后构成后置定语，相当于省略了关系从句。
bullets: the people present = the people who were present
the baby asleep in the crib
the best seat available；the only man alive

sections.p: 表示年龄、长度、高度、深度的形容词短语必须后置，因为中心数量词在前。少数源于法语的官职、法律词条也固定后置，需要整记。
bullets: a house two hundred years old；a river ten metres deep
the president elect；attorney general；court martial
present 前置意为“现在的”，后置意为“出席的”：the present situation / the people present

examples.en: Is there anything interesting in today's newspaper?
examples.zh: 今天的报纸上有什么有趣的内容吗？
examples.note: anything 是不定代词，形容词 interesting 必须后置。

examples.en: Is there interesting anything in today's newspaper?
examples.zh: 今天的报纸上有什么有趣的内容吗？
examples.note: 不定代词的修饰语不能前置，应改为 anything interesting。

examples.en: All the people present agreed with the proposal.
examples.zh: 所有在场的人都同意这项提议。
examples.note: present 后置表示“出席的”，相当于 who were present。

examples.en: All the present people agreed with the proposal.
examples.zh: 所有在场的人都同意这项提议。
examples.note: present 前置意为“现在的”，与“出席的”语义不同，此处应后置。

examples.en: This is the best hotel available in this price range.
examples.zh: 这是这个价位上能订到的最好的酒店。
examples.note: available 后置修饰 hotel，是 best + 名词 + available 的固定搭配。

examples.en: They live in a house two hundred years old.
examples.zh: 他们住在一栋有两百年历史的房子里。
examples.note: 度量短语 two hundred years old 后置修饰 house。

examples.en: He told us new nothing about the plan.
examples.zh: 关于这个计划，他没有告诉我们任何新情况。
examples.note: nothing 的修饰语必须后置，应改为 nothing new。

pitfalls.wrong: I have important something to tell you.
pitfalls.right: I have something important to tell you.
pitfalls.why: 不定代词 something 的修饰语只能后置，形容词不能插在代词前。

pitfalls.wrong: The asleep baby in the crib is only three months old.
pitfalls.right: The baby asleep in the crib is only three months old.
pitfalls.why: asleep 不能前置，作定语时放在名词后，相当于省略了 who was。

pitfalls.wrong: Is there else anything I can do for you?
pitfalls.right: Is there anything else I can do for you?
pitfalls.why: else 与形容词一样，修饰不定代词时必须后置。

contrast.withTitle: 形容词作定语与表语的位置限制
contrast.diff: 那一节点看形容词能否作定语；这里看能作定语的形容词在什么条件下必须移到名词之后。

concept.mnemonic: 不定代词、a- 形容词、度量短语，三者一来就后置。

core: 修饰 something/anything/nothing/everyone 等，形容词后置
else 同样后置：anything else, somebody else
表语形容词作定语须后置：the people present, the baby asleep
度量短语后置：a house two hundred years old
best/only/first + 名词 + available/possible；present 前置表“现在的”
review.trigger: 形容词要修饰不定代词或度量数量 → 一律放到名词后面

quickCheck.a: something important。

quickCheck.q: the people present 中的 present 是什么意思？
quickCheck.a: 出席的、在场的。
a house two hundred years old。

drills.stem: There is ___ in the report that you should pay attention to.
drills.answer: nothing new
drills.explain: nothing 是不定代词，形容词 new 只能后置修饰，构成 nothing new。
drills.trap: new nothing 把形容词放在不定代词前，违反后置规则。

drills.stem: The students ___ at the meeting were asked to sign the form. (present)
drills.answer: present
accept: present
drills.hint: 此处表示“出席的”，需要用后置定语。
drills.explain: present 后置表示“出席的”，相当于 who were present；前置则意为“现在的”。

drills.stem: I have important something to discuss with you after class.
drills.answer: I have something important to discuss with you after class.
accept: I have something important to discuss with you after class.
drills.explain: something 的修饰语必须后置，important 应移到 something 之后。

drills.stem: This is the only room ___ at the moment, so we should book it now.
drills.answer: available
drills.explain: available 是形容词，后置修饰 room，构成 the only room available。
drills.trap: availablely 是把形容词误加 ly 造出的副词，英语中不存在；availability 是名词。

drills.stem: 会上在场的人都同意这个计划。
drills.answer: Everyone present at the meeting agreed to the plan.
drills.explain: present 修饰不定代词 everyone 必须后置；agreed 与复数意义的主语搭配用过去式。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Is there anything else I can do for you?
drills.explain: else 修饰不定代词 anything 时必须后置，且后面接省略了 that 的定语从句。

items.title: 多个形容词并列的排序
items.brief: 观点到用途，越靠本质越近名词

concept.summary: 多个形容词修饰同一名词时按固定顺序排列：观点 → 大小 → 形状 → 年龄 → 颜色 → 国籍或产地 → 材料 → 用途，越接近事物本质的属性越靠近名词。顺序由“主观评价在外、客观属性在内”决定，不能随意调换。实际考试多为三个形容词的组合。

sections.p: 这八类属性按固定次序排列，理论上可以全部出现，实际写作中通常只取其中三类。判断时从最主观的一类往最客观的一类推。
bullets: 观点：beautiful, ugly, lovely, nice, comfortable
大小 → 形状 → 年龄：small, round, old
颜色 → 国籍 → 材料：brown, French, wooden
用途或类别紧贴名词：a writing desk, a sleeping bag

sections.p: 整条链条记不全时，先记这三组相对位置，它们覆盖了绝大多数考题。颜色在材料前、国籍在材料前、观点在最外层，这三条不能违反。
bullets: 颜色在材料前：a black leather jacket
国籍在材料前：a Chinese wooden box
观点在大小前：a beautiful small garden
大小在国籍前：a small Japanese camera

sections.p: 三个形容词的组合最常考，通常按“观点 + 大小/年龄 + 颜色/材料”的模式出现。四个以上属于书面描写，考试中出现频率低。
bullets: a lovely old Chinese vase
a big black leather bag
a small round wooden table

examples.en: She bought a beautiful small round wooden table.
examples.zh: 她买了一张漂亮的小圆木桌。
examples.note: 顺序为观点 beautiful、大小 small、形状 round、材料 wooden。

examples.en: She bought a wooden small round beautiful table.
examples.zh: 她买了一张漂亮的小圆木桌。
examples.note: 材料 wooden 应最靠近名词，观点 beautiful 应在最外层。

examples.en: He was wearing a black leather jacket.
examples.zh: 他穿着一件黑色皮夹克。
examples.note: 颜色 black 在材料 leather 之前。

examples.en: He was wearing a leather black jacket.
examples.zh: 他穿着一件黑色皮夹克。
examples.note: 材料不能排在颜色前，应为 a black leather jacket。

examples.en: They live in a lovely old Chinese house.
examples.zh: 他们住在一栋漂亮的中国老房子里。
examples.note: 顺序为观点 lovely、年龄 old、国籍 Chinese。

examples.en: They live in a Chinese lovely old house.
examples.zh: 他们住在一栋漂亮的中国老房子里。
examples.note: 国籍 Chinese 应靠近名词，观点 lovely 应移到最前。

examples.en: There is a big old brown wooden box in the attic.
examples.zh: 阁楼上有一个又大又旧的棕色木箱。
examples.note: 顺序为大小 big、年龄 old、颜色 brown、材料 wooden。

pitfalls.wrong: He was wearing a leather black jacket.
pitfalls.right: He was wearing a black leather jacket.
pitfalls.why: 颜色属于外观属性，材料属于本质属性，材料必须更靠近名词。

pitfalls.wrong: They visited an old beautiful church.
pitfalls.right: They visited a beautiful old church.
pitfalls.why: 观点形容词主观性最强，位置在最外层，不能被年龄词挤到后面。

pitfalls.wrong: She bought a Japanese small camera.
pitfalls.right: She bought a small Japanese camera.
pitfalls.why: 大小属于尺寸属性，位置在国籍之前。

contrast.withTitle: 形容词后置定语的情形
contrast.diff: 这一节点处理多个形容词前置时的相对顺序；后置定语处理单个形容词在什么条件下移到名词后，两者位置方向相反。

concept.mnemonic: 观大形龄色国材用，越靠本质越近名词。

core: 顺序：观点 → 大小 → 形状 → 年龄 → 颜色 → 国籍 → 材料 → 用途
观点最远，材料与用途最近
颜色在材料前：a black leather jacket
国籍在材料前：a Chinese wooden box
大小在国籍前：a small Japanese camera
review.trigger: 看到两个以上形容词修饰同一名词 → 先挑出观点词放最前，再把材料词推到名词前

quickCheck.a: a black leather jacket。

quickCheck.q: “漂亮的中国老房子”怎么排序？
quickCheck.a: a lovely old Chinese house。

quickCheck.q: 材料形容词应该放在哪里？
quickCheck.a: 最靠近名词的位置，只在用途词之前。

drills.stem: She put the flowers in a ___ vase.
drills.answer: small old glass
drills.explain: 按大小 → 年龄 → 材料的顺序排列，glass 表材料，必须最靠近名词。
drills.trap: glass old small 把材料提到最前，违反了材料最贴近名词的规则。

drills.stem: They bought a ___ table for the dining room. (round / wooden)
drills.answer: round wooden
accept: round wooden
drills.explain: shape 类形容词 round 位于材料 wooden 之前，且材料紧贴名词 table。

drills.stem: They moved into an old beautiful house near the river.
drills.answer: They moved into a beautiful old house near the river.
accept: They moved into a beautiful old house near the river.
drills.explain: 观点形容词 beautiful 应在年龄词 old 之前，同时冠词由 an 改为 a。

drills.stem: At the fair she bought a ___ scarf.
drills.answer: lovely red silk
drills.explain: 顺序为观点 lovely、颜色 red、材料 silk，材料 silk 紧贴名词 scarf。
drills.trap: lovely silk red 把颜色放到材料之后，颜色必须排在材料前。

drills.stem: 她穿着一件漂亮的红色丝绸连衣裙。
drills.answer: She was wearing a beautiful red silk dress.
drills.explain: 按观点 → 颜色 → 材料的顺序排列，beautiful 最前，silk 紧贴中心名词 dress。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: He bought a big old brown wooden box.
drills.explain: 按大小 big、年龄 old、颜色 brown、材料 wooden 的顺序排列，材料最靠近名词。

items.title: 副词的位置规则
items.brief: 频度在动词前、be 后，方式随宾语后

concept.summary: 副词位置由类别决定：频度副词放在实义动词之前、be 动词与助动词之后；方式副词放在动词或宾语之后；程度副词放在所修饰的形容词或副词之前；评注副词置于句首并用逗号隔开。方式副词不能插在动词与宾语之间。

sections.p: 频度副词的位置由谓语构成决定：只有实义动词时放在动词前；有 be 动词时放在 be 后；有助动词时放在第一个助动词之后。这条规则覆盖 always, usually, often, sometimes, seldom, hardly, never。
bullets: She always walks to work.
She is always late for meetings.
She has never been abroad.
× She arrives always late.

sections.p: 方式副词修饰动作，位置在动词后；若动词带宾语，则放在宾语之后，不能插入动词与宾语之间。程度副词修饰形容词或另一个副词时前置，只有 enough 例外，必须后置。
bullets: He speaks English fluently.
× He speaks fluently English.
The room is big enough for twenty people.
very / quite / rather + 形容词：quite difficult

sections.p: 评注副词表达说话人的态度，通常置于句首并用逗号与主句隔开。句末同时出现地点与时间状语时，地点在前、时间在后。
bullets: Fortunately, no one was hurt.
I met him at the station yesterday.
两个时间单位并列时，小单位在前：at seven on Monday morning

examples.en: She always arrives at the office before eight.
examples.zh: 她总是八点前到办公室。
examples.note: 频度副词 always 位于实义动词 arrives 之前。

examples.en: She arrives always at the office before eight.
examples.zh: 她总是八点前到办公室。
examples.note: 频度副词不能放在实义动词后，应移到 arrives 之前。

examples.en: He has never been to Japan.
examples.zh: 他从没去过日本。
examples.note: 频度副词 never 位于助动词 has 之后、过去分词之前。

examples.en: He has been never to Japan.
examples.zh: 他从没去过日本。
examples.note: never 应放在第一个助动词之后，而不是 be 动词或介词短语前。

examples.en: He speaks English fluently.
examples.zh: 他英语说得很流利。
examples.note: 方式副词 fluently 位于宾语 English 之后。

examples.en: He speaks fluently English.
examples.zh: 他英语说得很流利。
examples.note: 方式副词不能插在动词与宾语之间，应移到宾语后。

examples.en: Fortunately, no one was hurt in the accident.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，事故中没有人受伤。
examples.note: 评注副词置于句首，并用逗号与主句隔开。

pitfalls.wrong: I very like this novel.
pitfalls.right: I like this novel very much.
pitfalls.why: very 不能直接修饰动词，修饰动词要用 very much 并置于句末。

pitfalls.wrong: She goes always to the gym after work.
pitfalls.right: She always goes to the gym after work.
pitfalls.why: 频度副词必须放在实义动词之前，不能放在动词与介词短语之间。

pitfalls.wrong: He explained clearly the rules to the new students.
pitfalls.right: He explained the rules clearly to the new students.
pitfalls.why: 方式副词不能插在动词与宾语之间，须置于宾语 rules 之后。

contrast.withTitle: 副词与形容词的易混形式
contrast.diff: 这一节点管副词的“位置”，那一节点管副词的“形式”；位置错是语序问题，形式错是词性选错。

concept.mnemonic: 频度在动词前、be 后；方式跟宾语后；very 不碰动词。

core: 频度副词：实义动词前，be 动词与助动词后
方式副词：动词后或宾语后，不能插在动词与宾语之间
程度副词修饰形容词或副词前置，enough 后置
评注副词置于句首，用逗号隔开
地点状语在时间状语之前，时间小单位在前
review.trigger: 要放副词 → 先判类别（频度/方式/程度/评注）→ 再按该类别的固定落点安放

quickCheck.a: She is always late，频度副词在 be 后。
He speaks English well，方式副词在宾语后。

quickCheck.q: enough 修饰形容词时放在哪里？
quickCheck.a: 形容词之后，如 good enough。

drills.stem: She ___ goes to the gym before work.
drills.answer: usually
drills.explain: 句中已有实义动词 goes，频度副词 usually 直接放在它之前，不需要 be 动词。
drills.trap: usual 是形容词，不能修饰动词 goes；is usually 会与 goes 冲突，造成两个谓语。

drills.stem: He has ___ been to Japan, though he has travelled widely in Asia. (never)
drills.answer: never
accept: never
drills.hint: 句中已有助动词 has，频度副词放在助动词之后。
drills.explain: 频度副词位于第一个助动词之后，构成 has never been，表示“从未去过”。

drills.stem: He explained clearly the rules to the new students.
drills.answer: He explained the rules clearly to the new students.
accept: He explained the rules clearly to the new students.
drills.explain: 方式副词 clearly 不能插在动词 explained 与宾语 the rules 之间，须移到宾语之后。

drills.stem: The room is ___ for twenty people to sit comfortably.
drills.answer: big enough
drills.explain: enough 修饰形容词时必须后置，结构为形容词 + enough，故用 big enough。
drills.trap: enough big 按汉语语序排列，英语中 enough 只能放在形容词之后。

drills.stem: 他通常七点前到办公室。
drills.answer: He usually arrives at the office before seven.
drills.explain: 频度副词 usually 位于实义动词 arrives 之前；usual 是形容词，不能修饰动词。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She has never seen such a beautiful sunset.
drills.explain: 频度副词 never 位于助动词 has 之后、实义动词 seen 之前。

items.title: 副词与形容词的易混形式
items.brief: ly 结尾未必是副词，hardly 表几乎不

concept.summary: 加 -ly 不一定变副词，也不一定保留原义：hard 是“努力地”，hardly 是“几乎不”；late 是“迟”，lately 是“最近”；high 指空间高度，highly 指抽象程度。friendly, lovely, lonely, lively, likely, daily, early 虽以 ly 结尾仍是形容词，不能直接修饰动词。

sections.p: 这些词的两个形式都能独立使用，但语义已经分开，选错会直接改变句意。判断时先确定要表达的是字面义还是引申义。
bullets: hard 努力地 / hardly 几乎不
late 迟 / lately 最近
near 近 / nearly 几乎
high 空间高度 / highly 高度地、非常
wide 宽 / widely 广泛地；close 近 / closely 密切地
most 最 / mostly 主要地；deep 深 / deeply 深深地

sections.h: 形为 ly 的形容词
sections.p: 这类词由名词加 -ly 构成，本身就是形容词，不能作状语。需要副词表达时，改用介词短语 in a ... way，或换一个真正的副词。
bullets: friendly, lovely, lonely, lively, likely, silly, ugly
daily, weekly, monthly, yearly；early, costly, deadly
× He greeted me friendly. → He greeted me in a friendly way.

sections.p: look, sound, taste, smell, feel, seem, remain 后是表语位置，必须用形容词。well 只有在表示“健康”时才是形容词，表示“好”时是副词，不能放在系动词后描述事物。
bullets: The soup tastes good.（不是 well）
He looks tired after the long flight.
She feels well again.（well 表健康）

examples.en: He works hard and rarely takes a day off.
examples.zh: 他工作努力，很少休息。
examples.note: hard 作副词表示“努力地”，修饰 works。

examples.en: He works hardly and rarely takes a day off.
examples.zh: 他几乎不工作，很少休息。
examples.note: hardly 意为“几乎不”，与“工作努力”的语义相反。

examples.en: She has been very busy lately.
examples.zh: 她最近很忙。
examples.note: lately 表示“最近”，与现在完成时搭配。

examples.en: She has been very busy late.
examples.zh: 她最近很忙。
examples.note: late 意为“迟”，表示“最近”必须用 lately。

examples.en: He greeted us in a friendly way.
examples.zh: 他很友好地跟我们打招呼。
examples.note: friendly 是形容词，作状语要用 in a friendly way 这一介词短语。

examples.en: He greeted us friendly.
examples.zh: 他很友好地跟我们打招呼。
examples.note: friendly 不是副词，不能直接修饰动词 greeted。

examples.en: The soup tastes good.
examples.zh: 这汤味道不错。
examples.note: taste 是系动词，后面用形容词 good 作表语。

pitfalls.wrong: He works hardly every day.
pitfalls.right: He works hard every day.
pitfalls.why: hardly 意为“几乎不”，要表达“努力”必须用 hard。

pitfalls.wrong: She arrived lately for the meeting.
pitfalls.right: She arrived late for the meeting.
pitfalls.why: late 表示“迟”，lately 表示“最近”，两者语义不同。

pitfalls.wrong: The plane flew highly above the clouds.
pitfalls.right: The plane flew high above the clouds.
pitfalls.why: high 指空间上的高度，highly 表示抽象的程度，不能描述飞行高度。

contrast.diff: 这一节点判断该用形容词还是副词、用哪一个 -ly 词；位置规则解决选定之后放在句中什么位置。

concept.mnemonic: hard 努力 hardly 几乎不；late 迟到 lately 最近；ly 结尾未必是副词。

core: hard 努力地 / hardly 几乎不
late 迟 / lately 最近；near 近 / nearly 几乎
high 空间高度 / highly 抽象程度
friendly, lovely, lively, daily, early 是形容词，不是副词
系动词后用形容词：tastes good，不用 well
review.trigger: 看到 -ly 词要作状语 → 先查它是不是形容词 → 是则改用 in a ... way 或换词

quickCheck.a: He hardly works。

quickCheck.q: “她最近很忙”用 late 还是 lately？
quickCheck.a: lately，She has been busy lately.
不能，要用 in a friendly way。

drills.stem: He studies very ___, so his grades have improved a lot.
drills.answer: hard
drills.explain: 此处表示“努力地学习”，用副词 hard 修饰 studies，与后半句成绩提高相呼应。
drills.trap: hardly 意为“几乎不”，若填入则与“成绩大幅提高”自相矛盾。

drills.stem: I have not seen him ___ ; he must be busy with his thesis. (late)
drills.answer: lately
accept: lately
drills.hint: 现在完成时 + 否定，表示“最近一直没见到”。
drills.explain: lately 表示“最近”，与现在完成时的否定结构搭配；late 意为“迟”，语义不符。

drills.stem: She greeted the guests friendly and showed them to their seats.
drills.answer: She greeted the guests in a friendly way and showed them to their seats.
accept: She greeted the guests in a friendly way and showed them to their seats.
drills.explain: friendly 是形容词，不能作状语修饰 greeted，须改用介词短语 in a friendly way。

drills.stem: The little girl is very ___ and often sings for the neighbours.
drills.answer: lively
drills.explain: lively 虽以 ly 结尾却是形容词，表示“活泼的”，放在 is 后作表语。
drills.trap: livelyly 是把形容词误当词根再加 ly 造出的形式，英语中不存在。

drills.stem: 他几乎不锻炼，所以身体不太好。
drills.answer: He hardly ever exercises, so he is not very fit.
drills.explain: “几乎不”用 hardly，本身已含否定意义，句中不再加 not；hard 则表示“努力地”。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She has been working very hard lately.
drills.explain: hard 表“努力地”修饰 working，lately 表“最近”修饰整个完成进行时结构。

items.title: 比较级与最高级的构成
items.brief: 单音节加 er/est，多音节用 more/most

concept.summary: 比较级与最高级的构成由音节数和词尾决定：单音节及少数双音节加 -er/-est，多音节以及 -ful/-less/-ous/-ive/-ing/-ed 结尾的词用 more/most。以 e 结尾直接加 r/st，辅音加 y 变 ier/iest，重读闭音节双写末尾辅音。同一个词不能同时使用 more 与 -er。

sections.p: 单音节词一律走这一条路，双音节中只有少数常用词（narrow, quiet, clever, simple, polite）可以加 -er。变化时先处理词尾拼写，再加词缀。
bullets: 一般加 er/est：tall → taller → tallest
以 e 结尾加 r/st：nice → nicer → nicest
辅音 + y 变 ier/iest：happy → happier → happiest
重读闭音节双写：big → bigger → biggest；hot, thin, fat, wet

sections.p: 三个音节以上的词一律用 more/most；双音节中带 -ful, -less, -ous, -ive, -ing, -ed 后缀的词也用 more/most，因为这些后缀本身已构成一个音节单位。
bullets: interesting → more interesting → most interesting
careful, famous, active, tiring, tired 均用 more/most
以 ly 结尾的副词（early 除外）用 more/most：more quickly

sections.p: 不规则变化必须整记，其中 far 有两套形式，old 的 elder/eldest 只作定语，不能作表语。
bullets: good / well → better → best；bad / badly → worse → worst
many / much → more → most；little → less → least
far → farther / further → farthest / furthest
old → older / elder → oldest / eldest（elder, eldest 只作定语）

examples.en: This box is heavier than that one.
examples.zh: 这个箱子比那个重。
examples.note: heavy 是辅音加 y 结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 er。

examples.en: She is the most intelligent student in the class.
examples.zh: 她是班上最聪明的学生。
examples.note: intelligent 是多音节词，最高级用 most。

examples.en: He runs faster than his brother.
examples.zh: 他跑得比他哥哥快。
examples.note: fast 是单音节副词，比较级加 er。

examples.en: This book is more easier than that one.
examples.zh: 这本书比那本容易。
examples.note: easy 已用 er 构成比较级，不能再加 more，应改为 easier。

examples.en: He is the most tallest boy in the class.
examples.zh: 他是班上最高的男孩。
examples.note: tallest 已是最高级，不能再加 most，应改为 the tallest。

examples.en: My elder sister works in a hospital.
examples.zh: 我姐姐在医院工作。
examples.note: elder 只作前置定语，表示家庭成员中的年长者。

examples.en: The weather is getting worse.
examples.zh: 天气越来越糟。
examples.note: bad 的比较级是不规则形式 worse。

pitfalls.wrong: This problem is more easier than the last one.
pitfalls.right: This problem is easier than the last one.
pitfalls.why: easy 属辅音加 y 的双音节词，已经通过变 ier 构成比较级，不能再叠加 more。

pitfalls.wrong: She is the most tallest girl in her class.
pitfalls.right: She is the tallest girl in her class.
pitfalls.why: tall 是单音节词，最高级由 est 承担，most 与 est 不能同时出现。

pitfalls.wrong: He is more taller than his father.
pitfalls.right: He is taller than his father.
pitfalls.why: 比较级只能由一个标记承担，more 与 er 叠加属于双重比较级。

contrast.diff: 这一节点解决“比较级怎么写”，修饰语解决“比较级前面能加什么词”，如 much、far、even。

concept.mnemonic: 单音节加 er，多音节加 more；一个词只走一条路。

core: 单音节加 er/est；以 e 结尾加 r/st；辅音加 y 变 ier/iest
重读闭音节双写末尾辅音：bigger, hottest
多音节与 -ful/-less/-ous/-ive/-ing/-ed 用 more/most
不规则：better/best, worse/worst, more/most, less/least, further/furthest
禁止双重比较：× more easier，× most tallest
review.trigger: 要写比较级 → 先数音节 → 再查后缀 → 最后确认没有叠加 more

quickCheck.q: happy 的比较级和最高级？
quickCheck.a: happier, happiest。

quickCheck.q: careful 用 more 还是加 er？
quickCheck.a: 用 more careful, most careful。
不能，elder 只作定语，如 my elder brother。

drills.stem: This street is much ___ than the one we walked along yesterday.
drills.answer: wider
drills.explain: wide 是单音节词，比较级直接加 r 构成 wider，than 也印证了比较级结构。
drills.trap: more wide 把单音节词误按多音节处理；more wider 则是双重比较级。

drills.stem: Of all the subjects, chemistry is the ___ (difficult) for me.
drills.answer: most difficult
accept: most difficult
drills.hint: difficult 是多音节词，最高级用 most。
drills.explain: 多音节形容词的最高级由 most + 原级构成，且前面要加 the。

drills.stem: This exercise is more easier than the one in the textbook.
drills.answer: This exercise is easier than the one in the textbook.
accept: This exercise is easier than the one in the textbook.
drills.explain: easy 变比较级时把 y 改为 i 再加 er，已经承担了比较级标记，不能再加 more。

drills.stem: He sings ___ than anyone else in the choir.
drills.answer: better
drills.explain: well 的比较级是不规则形式 better，than 表明此处需要比较级。
drills.trap: gooder 是按规则类推造出的错误形式；more well 同样不成立。

drills.stem: 这条河比那条长得多。
drills.answer: This river is much longer than that one.
drills.explain: long 是单音节词，比较级为 longer，程度由 much 修饰，形成 much longer than。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She is the most careful student in her class.
drills.explain: careful 带 -ful 后缀，最高级用 most，并与 the 搭配。

items.title: 同级比较结构 as...as
items.brief: as 与 as 之间只用原级，数量分 many/much

concept.summary: 同级比较用 as + 形容词或副词原级 + as，否定式为 not as/so + 原级 + as，中间绝不出现比较级。涉及数量时用 as many + 可数名词复数 + as 或 as much + 不可数名词 + as。倍数、half、twice 等修饰语放在第一个 as 之前。

sections.p: as...as 是一个封闭框架，两个 as 必须成对出现。否定句可把第一个 as 换成 so，肯定句不能换成 so。
bullets: He is as tall as his father.
This film is not as interesting as the book.
否定也可用 not so interesting as，肯定句只能用 as
× as taller as：框架内必须是原级

sections.p: 比较数量时，形容词换成 many 或 much，依据是后面名词的可数性。名词必须放在第二个 as 之前。
bullets: She has as many books as her brother.
He earns as much money as his colleague.
We need as many as twenty chairs.（数量可达）

sections.p: 倍数与 half 放在第一个 as 之前，不能放在句中其他位置。as...as possible 与 as...as one can 是固定表达，表示“尽可能”。
bullets: twice as fast as；half as expensive as
Please reply as soon as possible.
Come as early as you can.

examples.en: He is as tall as his father.
examples.zh: 他和他父亲一样高。
examples.note: as 与 as 之间用原级 tall，构成同级比较。

examples.en: He is as taller as his father.
examples.zh: 他和他父亲一样高。
examples.note: as...as 框架内不能用比较级，taller 应改为 tall。

examples.en: This film is not as interesting as the book.
examples.zh: 这部电影不如书有趣。
examples.note: 否定句中第一个 as 可用 as 或 so，第二个 as 不变。

examples.en: She has as many books as her brother.
examples.zh: 她的书和她哥哥一样多。
examples.note: books 可数，数量比较用 as many as。

examples.en: She has as much books as her brother.
examples.zh: 她的书和她哥哥一样多。
examples.note: books 是可数名词复数，必须用 as many as，不能用 much。

examples.en: The new machine works twice as fast as the old one.
examples.zh: 新机器运转速度是旧机器的两倍。
examples.note: 倍数 twice 放在第一个 as 之前。

examples.en: Please reply as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 请尽快回复。
examples.note: as...as possible 表示“尽可能”，是固定表达。

pitfalls.wrong: He is as taller as his brother.
pitfalls.right: He is as tall as his brother.
pitfalls.why: as...as 是同级比较框架，中间只能放原级。

pitfalls.wrong: She has as much friends as her sister.
pitfalls.right: She has as many friends as her sister.
pitfalls.why: friends 是可数名词复数，数量比较要用 many 而不是 much。

pitfalls.wrong: The question is not so easier as it looks.
pitfalls.right: The question is not so easy as it looks.
pitfalls.why: so...as 结构同样要求原级，easier 应改为 easy。

contrast.diff: as...as 表示两者相同，中间用原级；比较级表示差异，前面可加 much/far/even，两者不能混用。

concept.mnemonic: as 与 as 之间只有原级；可数 many，不可数 much。

core: 肯定：as + 原级 + as；否定：not as/so + 原级 + as
框架内绝不出现比较级
可数用 as many + 复数名词 + as
不可数用 as much + 名词 + as
倍数与 half 放在第一个 as 之前
review.trigger: 看到 as...as → 先检查中间是不是原级 → 再看名词可数性选 many 还是 much

quickCheck.a: as tall as him。

quickCheck.q: “一样多的书”用 many 还是 much？
quickCheck.a: as many books as。

quickCheck.q: twice 放在 as...as 的哪个位置？
quickCheck.a: 第一个 as 之前，twice as fast as。

drills.stem: Her handwriting is ___ as her sister's.
drills.answer: as clear
drills.explain: 句中出现第二个 as，说明是同级比较，第一个空必须用 as + 原级 clear。
drills.trap: as clearer 在 as...as 框架中误用比较级，是本题最强干扰项。

drills.stem: The exam was not so ___ (hard) as we had expected.
drills.answer: hard
accept: hard
drills.hint: so...as 结构中同样要用原级。
drills.explain: not so...as 是同级比较的否定形式，中间必须用原级 hard。

drills.stem: This room is as larger as the one upstairs.
drills.answer: This room is as large as the one upstairs.
accept: This room is as large as the one upstairs.
drills.explain: as...as 之间只能用原级，larger 应改为 large。

drills.stem: He earns ___ money as his colleague, though he works longer hours.
drills.answer: as much
drills.explain: money 是不可数名词，同级比较的数量表达用 as much...as；肯定句不用 so。
drills.trap: as many 只能修饰可数名词复数；so much 只用于否定或疑问的同级比较。

drills.stem: 这本书和那本一样有趣。
drills.answer: This book is as interesting as that one.
drills.explain: 同级比较用 as + 原级 + as；so...than 与 as...more 都破坏了框架的对称性。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She can run as fast as her brother.
drills.explain: as 与 as 之间用副词原级 fast，构成同级比较，修饰动词 run。

items.title: 比较级的修饰语
items.brief: much/far/even 修饰比较级，very 不行

concept.summary: 能修饰比较级的词有 much, far, a lot, a great deal, even, still, rather, slightly, a little, a bit, no, any 以及数量短语（two years）。very, quite, so, too, fairly 只能修饰原级。修饰语一律放在比较级之前，句中不能再出现第二个比较级标记。

sections.p: 这些词表示差距的大小或递进关系，与比较级搭配构成固定组合。数量短语表示具体差距，位置同样在比较级之前。
bullets: much / far / a lot / a great deal + 比较级：much taller
even / still + 比较级：表递进，even colder
slightly / a little / a bit + 比较级：表差距微小
数量短语：three years older, two kilos heavier

sections.p: very, quite, so, too, fairly, pretty 的语义是“程度很高”，它们只能修饰原级形容词或副词。要表达同样的意思，须换成 much 或 far。
bullets: × very taller；√ very tall / much taller
× quite better；√ quite good / much better
× too more expensive；√ much more expensive

sections.h: no 与 not 的语义差别
sections.p: no + 比较级表示“并不更……”，是对两者的同时否定；not + 比较级只表示程度上的不如。no more than 意为“只有”，not more than 意为“不超过”。
bullets: He is no more careful than his brother.（两人都不细心）
He is not more careful than his brother.（不如他哥哥细心）
no more than ten = only ten；not more than ten = at most ten

examples.en: This problem is much more difficult than the previous one.
examples.zh: 这道题比上一道难得多。
examples.note: much 修饰多音节形容词的比较级 more difficult。

examples.en: This problem is very more difficult than the previous one.
examples.zh: 这道题比上一道难得多。
examples.note: very 只能修饰原级，修饰比较级要用 much。

examples.en: He is two years older than his sister.
examples.zh: 他比妹妹大两岁。
examples.note: 数量短语 two years 表示具体差距，放在比较级之前。

examples.en: The weather is even colder than it was yesterday.
examples.zh: 今天天气比昨天还冷。
examples.note: even 修饰比较级 colder，表示程度递进。

examples.en: She is very taller than her mother.
examples.zh: 她比她妈妈高很多。
examples.note: very 不能修饰比较级，应改为 much taller。

examples.en: This bag is slightly heavier than that one.
examples.zh: 这个包比那个稍重一点。
examples.note: slightly 表示差距很小，修饰比较级 heavier。

examples.en: He is no more careful than his brother.
examples.zh: 他和他哥哥一样不细心。
examples.note: no more...than 对两者同时否定，意为“两者都不”。

pitfalls.wrong: He is very taller than his brother.
pitfalls.right: He is much taller than his brother.
pitfalls.why: very 修饰原级，比较级前的程度词必须换成 much 或 far。

pitfalls.wrong: This box is a bit more heavier than that one.
pitfalls.right: This box is a bit heavier than that one.
pitfalls.why: a bit 可以修饰比较级，但 heavier 已含比较级标记，不能再加 more。

pitfalls.wrong: The tickets are very cheaper this month.
pitfalls.right: The tickets are much cheaper this month.
pitfalls.why: cheaper 是比较级，前面不能用 very，只能用 much、far 一类词。

contrast.diff: 同级比较用原级并受 as...as 框架约束；比较级表差异，前面用 much/far/even 等程度词修饰，两者标记词不同。

concept.mnemonic: very 只爱原级，much 专宠比较级。

core: 可修饰比较级：much, far, a lot, even, still, rather, slightly, a little, a bit, no, any
不可修饰比较级：very, quite, so, too, fairly, pretty
数量短语表差距：three years older
修饰语位置在比较级之前
no more than = 只有；not more than = 不超过
review.trigger: 看到比较级前要加程度词 → 先排除 very/quite/too → 换成 much/far/even

quickCheck.a: 不能，要用 much 或 far。
two years older。

quickCheck.q: no more than ten 是什么意思？
quickCheck.a: 只有十个。

drills.stem: The new library is ___ larger than the old one.
drills.answer: much
drills.explain: larger 是比较级，前面只能用 much、far 一类程度词修饰。
drills.trap: very 只能修饰原级 large，不能与比较级 larger 搭配。

drills.stem: My sister is three years ___ (old) than me.
drills.answer: older
accept: older
drills.hint: three years 表具体差距，后面要用比较级。
drills.explain: 数量短语 three years 后接比较级 older，构成 three years older than。

drills.stem: This laptop is very more expensive than the one I bought last year.
drills.answer: This laptop is much more expensive than the one I bought last year.
accept: This laptop is much more expensive than the one I bought last year.
drills.explain: more expensive 是比较级结构，前面的程度词不能用 very，须改为 much。

drills.stem: The final exam was ___ easier than we had expected.
drills.answer: a lot
drills.explain: a lot 可以修饰比较级 easier，表示差距很大；其余三个词只能修饰原级。
drills.trap: very 是最强干扰项，学生常按汉语“非常容易”直译，但 very 不能与比较级连用。

drills.stem: 他比我高一点。
drills.answer: He is a little taller than me.
drills.explain: “一点”用 a little / a bit / slightly 修饰比较级 taller，不能叠加 more。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The weather is even worse than it was yesterday.
drills.explain: even 修饰不规则比较级 worse，表示“比昨天还糟”。

items.title: 最高级的范围限定
items.brief: 最高级要带 the，并用 in 或 of 限定范围

concept.summary: 最高级要满足两个条件：前面加 the（副词最高级可省），后面给出比较范围。范围用 in + 场所或组织（in the class, in China），或 of + 同类个体（of the three, of all）。有物主代词时不再加 the；one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词，谓语用单数。

sections.p: 最高级表示“三者及以上中最突出的一个”，必须有明确的比较范围，否则句子在逻辑上不完整。定冠词 the 与范围标记通常同时出现。
bullets: She is the tallest girl in her class.
The Yangtze is the longest river in China.
This is the best of the three.
副词最高级可省 the：He runs fastest in the team.

sections.h: in 与 of 的分工
sections.p: in 后接场所、组织或整体范围，of 后接同类个体的集合。与集体比较用 in，与若干同类事物比较用 of。
bullets: in the world / in China / in our class
of the three / of all the students
× the tallest of his class（应为 in his class）

sections.p: 这三个句式把最高级与名词、完成时、序数词绑定，形式固定，考试中出现频率高。
bullets: one of the most + 形容词 + 复数名词：one of the most important cities
the + 序数词 + 最高级：the second largest city
the + 最高级 + 名词 + I have ever seen / read

examples.en: She is the tallest girl in her class.
examples.zh: 她是班上最高的女孩。
examples.note: 最高级 tallest 前加 the，范围用 in her class。

examples.en: She is tallest girl in her class.
examples.zh: 她是班上最高的女孩。
examples.note: 最高级前缺定冠词 the，这是最高频的漏词错误。

examples.en: It is one of the most beautiful cities in the world.
examples.zh: 它是世界上最美丽的城市之一。
examples.note: one of 后接最高级加复数名词 cities。

examples.en: It is one of the most beautiful city in the world.
examples.zh: 它是世界上最美丽的城市之一。
examples.note: one of 后的名词必须是复数，city 应改为 cities。

examples.en: This is the best novel I have ever read.
examples.zh: 这是我读过的最好的小说。
examples.note: 最高级与 ever 连用，后面接省略了 that 的定语从句。

examples.en: Shanghai is the largest city in China.
examples.zh: 上海是中国最大的城市。
examples.note: 与国家这一整体范围比较用 in。

examples.en: He is the tallest of his class.
examples.zh: 他是班上最高的。
examples.note: 与集体范围比较应用 in his class，of 后应接同类个体。

pitfalls.wrong: Shanghai is largest city in China.
pitfalls.right: Shanghai is the largest city in China.
pitfalls.why: 最高级前必须加定冠词 the，表示独一无二的那一个。

pitfalls.wrong: He is one of the tallest student in the class.
pitfalls.right: He is one of the tallest students in the class.
pitfalls.why: one of 表示“其中之一”，后面的名词必须是复数。

pitfalls.wrong: He is the tallest of his class.
pitfalls.right: He is the tallest in his class.
pitfalls.why: his class 是一个集体范围，与集体比较用 in，of 后应接同类个体。

contrast.diff: 最高级要与范围和 the 搭配，比较级要与 than 搭配；看到 than 就不能用最高级，看到 in/of 范围就不能用比较级。

concept.mnemonic: 最高级两件套：the 加范围；集体用 in，同类用 of。

core: 最高级前加 the，副词最高级可省
范围：in + 场所或组织；of + 同类个体
one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词，谓语用单数
the + 序数词 + 最高级：the second largest city
物主代词前不加 the：my best friend
review.trigger: 写最高级 → 先补 the → 再问“在什么范围内” → 集体用 in，同类用 of

quickCheck.a: the tallest boy in his class。

quickCheck.q: one of 后面用单数还是复数名词？
quickCheck.a: 复数，one of the best students。

quickCheck.q: “我最好的朋友”要不要加 the？
quickCheck.a: 不加，my best friend。

drills.stem: The Yellow River is the second ___ river in China.
drills.answer: longest
drills.explain: the second 后接最高级表示“第二长”，范围由 in China 限定。
drills.trap: longer 是比较级，与 the second 和范围短语 in China 都不匹配。

drills.stem: This is one of the most interesting ___ (book) I have ever read.
drills.answer: books
accept: books
drills.hint: one of 表示“其中之一”，后面的名词要用复数。
drills.explain: one of the most interesting books 中，of 后是若干同类个体，名词必须用复数。

drills.stem: He is tallest student in his class.
drills.answer: He is the tallest student in his class.
accept: He is the tallest student in his class.
drills.explain: 最高级 tallest 前必须加定冠词 the，与范围 in his class 配套。

drills.stem: It is ___ film I have ever seen.
drills.answer: the best
drills.explain: 与 ever 连用的最高级句式要求 the + 最高级 + 名词，故用 the best film。
drills.trap: best 前缺 the 是最高频错误；the better 用于两者比较，与 ever 不搭。

drills.stem: 他是班上最高的男孩。
drills.answer: He is the tallest boy in his class.
drills.explain: 最高级前加 the，与集体范围比较用 in his class，不用 of。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: This is one of the most important cities in the world.
drills.explain: one of 后接最高级与复数名词 cities，范围由 in the world 限定。

items.title: the more..., the more... 结构
items.brief: 两个 the 各带一个比较级，前因后果

concept.summary: the + 比较级..., the + 比较级... 表示“越……就越……”，前一分句是条件，后一分句是结果。两个 the 都不能省，比较级必须紧跟 the，主句不能用倒装；从句用一般现在时表将来，主句用将来时。比较级后可直接接名词，如 the more money。

sections.p: 这个结构由两个分句组成，每个分句都以 the + 比较级开头。the 是副词，修饰后面的比较级，不是冠词，因此不能省略也不能换成 more。
bullets: The more you read, the more you know.
× More you read, more you know.
比较级紧跟 the：the more fluent you will become
主句不倒装：× the more will you know

sections.p: 从句用一般现在时表示将来，主句才用 will。两个分句的主语谓语在语义清楚时可以省略，形成 the more, the better 这类固定说法。
bullets: The earlier you start, the sooner you will finish.
× The earlier you will start...
The more, the better. / The sooner, the better.
The less you worry, the better you sleep.

sections.h: 与 more and more 的分工
sections.p: more and more + 原级表示同一事物程度持续加深，只涉及一个变化；the more..., the more... 表示两个变化之间的因果关联，必须有两条比较级。
bullets: Life is getting more and more expensive.（一个变化）
The more expensive life becomes, the less people save.（两个变化相关联）

examples.en: The more you practise, the more confident you become.
examples.zh: 你练习得越多，就越自信。
examples.note: 两个 the 各带一个比较级，前为条件，后为结果。

examples.en: More you practise, more confident you become.
examples.zh: 你练习得越多，就越自信。
examples.note: 两个 the 都不能省，缺 the 就不是该关联结构。

examples.en: The earlier you book the tickets, the cheaper they will be.
examples.zh: 你越早订票，票价就越便宜。
examples.note: 从句用一般现在时 book，主句用将来时 will be。

examples.en: The more carefully you plan, the fewer mistakes you will make.
examples.zh: 你计划得越仔细，犯的错误就越少。
examples.note: 比较级 carefully 与 fewer 分别紧跟两个 the。

examples.en: The more you eat, the more you will get fat.
examples.zh: 你吃得越多，就会越胖。
examples.note: 第二个 the 后必须紧跟比较级，应改为 the fatter you will get。

examples.en: The more, the better.
examples.zh: 越多越好。
examples.note: 省略主语和谓语后的固定说法，两个 the 仍保留。

examples.en: Life is getting more and more expensive.
examples.zh: 生活变得越来越贵。
examples.note: more and more 表示单一程度的持续加深，不是关联结构。

pitfalls.wrong: More you read, more you know.
pitfalls.right: The more you read, the more you know.
pitfalls.why: 该结构中的 the 是修饰比较级的副词，两个都不能省略。

pitfalls.wrong: The more you practise, the more you will become confident.
pitfalls.right: The more you practise, the more confident you will become.
pitfalls.why: 第二个 the 后必须紧跟比较级，more confident 应连在一起放在分句前部。

pitfalls.wrong: The earlier you will start, the sooner you will finish.
pitfalls.right: The earlier you start, the sooner you will finish.
pitfalls.why: 从句用一般现在时表将来，will 只出现在主句中。

contrast.diff: 本结构要求两个 the 与两个比较级成对出现；修饰语只是在单个比较级前加程度词，不构成关联结构。

concept.mnemonic: 两 the 两比较，前条件后结果；从句现在时，主句将来时。

core: 结构：the + 比较级 + 分句，the + 比较级 + 分句
两个 the 都不能省，比较级紧跟 the
前一分句是条件，后一分句是结果
从句用一般现在时表将来，主句用 will
与 more and more 的区别：一个变化对比两个关联变化
review.trigger: 看到“越……越……” → 先写两个 the，再各接一个比较级，最后核对时态

quickCheck.a: The more you practise, the more confident you become.
不能，从句用一般现在时表将来。

quickCheck.q: The more, the better 为什么可以省略？
quickCheck.a: 语义清楚时两个分句的主语和谓语可以省略。

drills.stem: ___ you read, the more you will understand the author's intention.
drills.answer: The more
drills.explain: 该结构要求两个 the 成对出现，后半句已有 the more，前半句也必须用 The more。
drills.trap: More 缺少 the，无法构成 the + 比较级 的关联结构。

drills.stem: The earlier you leave, the ___ (soon) you will arrive.
drills.answer: sooner
accept: sooner
drills.hint: the 后面必须接比较级形式。
drills.explain: 第二个 the 后要接比较级，soon 的比较级是 sooner，与前句 the earlier 形成对应。

drills.stem: The more you practise, the more you will become fluent.
drills.answer: The more you practise, the more fluent you will become.
accept: The more you practise, the more fluent you will become.
drills.explain: 第二个 the 后必须紧跟比较级，more fluent 应连在一起，构成 the more fluent you will become。

drills.stem: The ___ the economy grows, the more energy the country consumes.
drills.answer: faster
drills.explain: the 后必须接比较级，fast 的比较级是 faster，与后半句 the more 对应。
drills.trap: fast 是原级，fastest 是最高级，两者都不能进入 the + 比较级 的槽位。

drills.stem: 你越早开始，就越早完成。
drills.answer: The earlier you start, the sooner you will finish.
drills.explain: 两个 the 各带一个比较级；从句用一般现在时 start，将来由主句的 will finish 承担。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The more careful you are, the fewer mistakes you will make.
drills.explain: 第一个 the 后接 more careful，第二个 the 后接 fewer mistakes，两个分句由逗号分隔。
